_note: TEMPLATE for the private deny-list used by credential-scan.mjs --tier public. Copy it OUTSIDE every repository (default locations: <vault>/private/secure-push/public-denylist.json, or ~/.secure-push/public-denylist.json; or pass --denylist / set SECURE_PUSH_DENYLIST) and fill in your real terms. Never commit the filled copy: secure-push is published, so a deny-list tracked beside it would publish the names it exists to keep out. The public tier refuses to run (exit 2) without one.

patterns.name: owner-surname
patterns._why: Your name. LICENSE is the one place it belongs.

patterns.name: client-acme
patterns._why: One entry per client. Never name a client in a public artifact.

patterns.name: partner-name
patterns._why: People you work with, by first name if it is distinctive enough.

patterns.name: storage-setup
patterns._why: Anything that describes your private setup that a stranger has no need to know.
